name: gcp-to-aws
description: Convert Google Cloud (GCP) workloads to AWS. Paste GCP Terraform, config, or SDK code in any Claude app and get the AWS version, or plan and run a full migration of compute, serverless, big data, and storage in Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Convert Google Cloud (GCP) workloads to AWS. Paste GCP Terraform, config, or SDK code in any Claude app and get the AWS version, or plan and run a full migration of compute, serverless, big data, and storage in Claude Code. Keeps resumable migration state in .migration/, inventories GCP resources before changing anything, and checks each migrated piece for parity with the original.
defaultPrompt: Convert this GCP Terraform to AWS
Plan a migration of this GCP project to AWS
